description: Plays one MPX part through an oscillator: a polyphonic pitch output, a channel per string, for the oscillator, and its audio returned through a filter and an amplitude envelope on each string, panned and mixed to stereo.

params.name: Attack
params.text: How long a struck string takes to reach its level, from 1 ms, a hard pick, to 1 s, a swell.

params.name: Decay
params.text: How long a held string takes to fall 60 dB, from 0.1 s, a muted plunk, to 20 s. There is no sustain level: the string falls for as long as it is held.

params.name: Release
params.text: How long a string takes to fall 60 dB once its note has ended, from 5 ms to 2 s.

params.name: Cutoff
params.text: The filter's cutoff for a string at middle C, from 20 Hz to 20 kHz. Key tracking moves it with each string's pitch, and the performer's timbre moves it down for a palm mute or a dead note and up for a harmonic.

params.name: Resonance
params.text: Emphasis at the cutoff, from a flat response at 0% to a peak about 20 dB high at 100%.

params.name: Key tracking
params.text: How far the cutoff follows each string's pitch: at 100%, an octave of cutoff for every octave of pitch.

params.name: Slope
params.text: The filter's slope: 12 dB per octave unlit, 24 dB per octave lit.

params.name: Filter
params.text: Lit, each string's audio passes through the filter; unlit, it goes to its envelope unfiltered.

params.name: Filter attack
params.text: How long each string's filter envelope takes to rise to its peak, from 1 ms to 1 s.

params.name: Filter decay
params.text: How long each string's filter envelope takes to fall 60 dB from its peak, from 20 ms to 10 s, whether the note is held or not.

params.name: Filter envelope depth
params.text: How far the filter envelope raises the cutoff at its peak, from 0 to 6 octaves.

inputs.name: MPX note
inputs.text: One part: its notes and how each is played, from Guitar Chart or any MPX source.

inputs.name: Return audio
inputs.text: The oscillator's audio, one channel per string in the order the pitch output sends them. A single channel is used for every string, which sounds right only for a part that plays one note at a time.

outputs.name: 1V/oct, as played
outputs.text: Each string's pitch as played, 1V per octave with 0V at middle C, one channel per string, with the bends, slides and vibrato in it, for a polyphonic oscillator whose output comes back to the return.

outputs.name: Left
outputs.text: The strings, filtered, shaped and panned, mixed to stereo.

outputs.name: Right
outputs.text: The strings, filtered, shaped and panned, mixed to stereo.

outputs.name: Filter envelope
outputs.text: Each string's filter envelope, 0 to 10V, one channel per string, for driving other modules in time with the plucks.

notes: A hammer-on, pull-off or legato slide is not struck again: the pitch moves under envelopes that carry on from where the string was.
The performance rules are read from DreamerMPX/perform.txt and read again from the right- click menu.
